program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text = '''def transform(grid):
    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        i = 0
        while i < len(row):
            if row[i] == background:
                i += 1
                continue
            color = row[i]
            counts[color] = counts.get(color, 0) + 1
            while i < len(row) and row[i] == color:
                i += 1
    cells = [color for color in sorted(counts, reverse=True) for _ in range(counts[color])]
    out = [[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
    for i, color in enumerate(cells[:6]):
        out[i // 3][i % 3] = color
    return out
'''
